title: Cable delivered
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the old generator room in the base of the lighthouse: a riveted iron backup generator, a switchboard of brass levers and gauges, cables and an iron gate. Time and weather: night, renewed storm, slate-blue darkness pierced by crimson drone optics and emerald threat light.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks; Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking.
Camera: through the power-room window as the cable arrives; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: The hero swings past the power-room window and flings the heavy cable through it; Penny leans out and catches it in both gloved hands.
No dialogue.
Sound: whoosh, glass rattling, cable thump into gloves.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
